say:0:1011211001:0.text: So this is the Bizarre Labyrinth... Why are there so many portals?
say:0:1011211001:0.source_cn: 这就是诡幻迷宫……怎么会有这么多传送石门？
say:0:1011211001:0.male: So this is the Bizarre Labyrinth... Why are there so many portals?
say:0:1011211001:0.female: So this is the Bizarre Labyrinth... Why are there so many portals?

say:1:1011211002:0.text: It's a relic from centuries ago, even the oldest elder don't know where it came from.
say:1:1011211002:0.source_cn: 这是数百年前的遗迹，最年长的长者也不知道它的来历。
say:1:1011211002:0.male: It's a relic from centuries ago, even the oldest elder don't know where it came from.
say:1:1011211002:0.female: It's a relic from centuries ago, even the oldest elder don't know where it came from.

say:2:1011211003:0.text: It's very easy to get lost in here. The Dusk Patrollers don't come here often either.
say:2:1011211003:0.source_cn: 嗯，这里很容易迷路，所以我们巡游队也不常来。
say:2:1011211003:0.male: It's very easy to get lost in here. The Dusk Patrollers don't come here often either.
say:2:1011211003:0.female: It's very easy to get lost in here. The Dusk Patrollers don't come here often either.
